summary: The Rittman Exempted Village School urges the FCC to preserve the core mission of the E-Rate program and avoid policies that would significantly reduce support for schools and libraries. The school emphasizes the essential role of E-Rate in providing reliable broadband access for student learning, teacher instruction, family connectivity, and school operations. The school highlights the collaborative work of the Instructional Technology Centers (ITCs) in delivering high-quality technology servic The comment expresses concerns about the impact of weakening E-Rate on school districts, emphasizing the importance of broadband connectivity for various school operations and communication needs. It argues that weakening E-Rate would have far-reaching consequences beyond just the cost of internet service, potentially reducing educational opportunities, increasing operational costs, and leaving schools more vulnerable to cybersecurity risks.
